dct_description_sm: Contained within the Atlas of Canada's Reference Map Series, 1961 to 2010, is a small black-and-white map at 250 miles to the inch (or 1: 15 840 000). It is undated, but was produced after 1966 as its publishing agency was the Department of Energy, Mines and Resources (which was so-named as of that year). The map shows capital cities, major places, major railways and some drainage. However, there are no names used anywhere on the map.
